Initial release of skylv-data-validator.

- Validates JSON, CSV, and Excel data against defined schemas
- Supports 17 built-in validation rules, including type, pattern, email, URL, UUID, and more
- Enables schema inference from example data
- Performs data quality checks across multiple formats
- Trigger keywords: data validation, json schema, csv validation, data quality
